name: hyperqualia
title: hyperqualia
blurb: a rotating tesseract standing in for a mind too large to read directly — a real hyperplane slice through it is the only part that ever reaches you, and it occasionally passes near breathwork, ayahuasca, prayer, or DMT. rewritten quieter after @fubarchitect.com asked for less tool-poster, more alan watts; the hand-written GLSL backdrop now also carries the four rotation planes the panels have no readout for.
